title: No ‘Uptober’ Yet: Bitcoin Slips 2% in a Month That’s Historically Bullish
summary: Bitcoin Magazine No ‘Uptober’ Yet: Bitcoin Slips 2% in a Month That’s Historically Bullish Bitcoin’s price is currently down so far in October — albeit slightly — as speculators last week cashed out of ETFs. Will investors change course? This post No ‘Uptober’ Yet: Bitcoin Slips 2% in a Month That’s Historically Bullish first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .
